Definition: from G5530; employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body):--use.
BiblicalUsage: Use here is the employment of the body, and Paul says men and women exchanged the natural use for what is against nature. The word is plain, and Paul uses it to name a sin that turns God's design upside down.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Paul is plain because the truth is plain: God designed the body with a purpose, and turning from that purpose is sin.
